claims.statement: The running app always connects with DATABASE_URL; DATABASE_URL_DIRECT is used only when DATABASE_CONNECTION is direct, which pnpm migrate sets.
Without a database URL, resolveDatabaseUrl throws in production outside the build phase and otherwise returns the embedded development database URL; blank values count as unset.

The embedded development database listens on 127.0.0.1:54329 with user and password postgres, uses ta_web for the app and separate ta_web_e2e, ta_web_integration and ta_web_lhci databases for tests and Lighthouse CI, with data in .postgres/data.
pnpm db:dev initializes the cluster only when PG_VERSION is missing, creates the ta_web database if absent, warns when DATABASE_URL is set, and stops Postgres on SIGINT or SIGTERM.
resetDevDatabase force-drops and recreates a single named database inside the embedded cluster.
Payload schema push is enabled only when NODE_ENV is development; all other contexts apply committed migrations.

There are twenty-eight migrations today, from 20261103_030359_initial to 20261114_011851_users_roles, including those for quest stages, checklists, subareas, dungeons, the achievement prose snapshot, dungeon picks and panel roles, registered in src/migrations/index.ts.
The initial migration creates the users, users_sessions, media, media_variants and media_locales tables plus Payload system tables.
Railway runs pnpm migrate as the pre-deploy command with a 600-second timeout, and a failed migration stops the deploy while the previous version keeps serving.
The Postgres pool uses a 5 second connection timeout and logs pool errors instead of crashing.

The quests migration creates the quests, quests_locales, quests_rels, quests_start_positions and quests_start_positions_locales tables, a unique index on quests.dofus_id and a quests_id column on payload_locked_documents_rels, and its down drops them.
The quests migration's down does not drop payload_locked_documents_rels_quests_fk separately, because DROP TABLE "quests" CASCADE already removes that foreign key.

tests/integration/migrations.test.ts runs pnpm payload migrate:down and then pnpm payload migrate against the integration database with DATABASE_CONNECTION=direct, asserting the latest migration in src/migrations/index.ts is rolled back and re-applied.
The migrations test uses the Payload CLI because Payload imports migrations with Node rather than Vitest, and avoids migrate:refresh because in Payload 3.92 it rolls back oldest first and fails.
When a Payload CLI command fails, the migrations test rethrows an error that includes the command's stdout and stderr.

The quest_guides migration creates quest_guides with a unique slug index and a _status enum defaulting to draft, quest_guides_locales, quest_guides_rels, a table and _locales table per body block type, the _quest_guides_v version tables, and a quest_guides_id column on payload_locked_documents_rels; its down drops them.
The quest_guides migration's down does not drop payload_locked_documents_rels_quest_guides_fk separately, because DROP TABLE "quest_guides" CASCADE already removes it.
The migrations test sets its own 120-second timeout because it starts the Payload CLI twice, which can exceed the 30-second default on a loaded machine.

The dofusdb_items_rewards migration creates items and monsters with unique dofus_id indexes and _locales tables, the quests_rewards_items, quests_needs_items, quests_needs_monsters and quests_numbers tables, the rewards_experience, rewards_kamas and needs_walks_maps columns on quests, and items_id and monsters_id columns on payload_locked_documents_rels; its down drops them.

The dofusdb_items_rewards migration's down does not drop the payload_locked_documents_rels items and monsters foreign keys separately, because dropping the items and monsters tables with CASCADE already removes them.
The dofusdb_item_supertype migration adds a nullable numeric super_type_id column to items, and its down drops that column.

The needs_list migration creates quest_guides_summary_needs_items and its version twin with an item_id referencing items (ON DELETE set null) and a quantity defaulting to 1, and renames summary_needs to summary_needs_notes in quest_guides_locales and version_summary_needs to version_summary_needs_notes in _quest_guides_v_locales, keeping existing text per locale.
The needs_list migration's down drops the two needs item tables and renames the notes columns back, so the notes return to the old text column and the item rows are lost.

tests/integration/needs-list-migration.test.ts calls the needs_list migration's down and up on the migrated integration database with a real guide, checks the text sits in summary_needs after down, and checks after up that the guide and its version read the old text as summary.needs.notes with an empty item list, running up in a finally block.

The guide_single_quest migration's up adds quest_guides.quest_id and _quest_guides_v.version_quest_id, copies into them each guide's and each version's linked quest with the lowest order from quest_guides_rels and _quest_guides_v_rels, then drops both relation tables and adds foreign keys to quests with ON DELETE set null and an index on each column.

The guide_single_quest migration's down recreates quest_guides_rels and _quest_guides_v_rels, writes each linked quest back as a relation row with order 1, and drops the quest_id and version_quest_id columns.

tests/integration/guide-single-quest-migration.test.ts calls the guide_single_quest migration's down on a guide linked to one quest, checks the quest is a relation row for the guide and its version, adds a second quest with order 2, runs up in a finally block, and checks that quest_id, version_quest_id and Payload's quest field on the guide and its versions hold the first quest.

ensureDevDatabase reuses a Postgres already listening on the embedded port, otherwise spawns scripts/db-dev.ts, waits up to 120 seconds for the port and stops the spawned process before rethrowing if it never opens; integration and Lighthouse CI setups share it.
stopProcess resolves immediately when the child has already exited or was killed by a signal, and otherwise sends SIGTERM and resolves on exit.
The media_image_sizes migration drops media_variants and adds per-size URL, dimension, MIME type, file size and filename columns with filename indexes to media; its down recreates media_variants.

The guide_v4_quest_npcs migration creates npcs and npcs_locales with render foreign keys to media, adds media.game_asset, the quest achievement and experience_min columns and the localized zone and achievement name, and its down drops them.
isLocalDatabaseUrl accepts only localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] hosts, and pnpm seed:e2e exits with an error when the resolved database URL is not local.

A Postgres client lost while checked out for a transaction is logged by the per-client error listener installed in pool.onConnect instead of crashing the process; the transaction owner receives the error and the transaction is not retried.
The guide_v5_game_images_fight migration adds the fight block tables with version twins and an image_id column on items and monsters referencing media with ON DELETE set null.

The achievements_game_data migration creates achievement_categories and achievements with their locales, quests, reward items, counts-for and rels tables; the achievement_pages_groups migration creates achievement_pages and achievement_groups with their locales, rels, quest and reward tables and version tables.
databaseScriptRefusal requires --production in production and --remote for a database on another host, and lets an empty DATABASE_URL run without flags.

The dofus_guides migration creates dofus_guides with its locales, Necesitarás group tables, part and body block tables, the dofus_meta_ach metalogro rows and the _dofus_guides_v version tables; dofus_guides_import adds video_poster_id and import_snapshot; dofus_guides_index creates the global's tables.
The users_roles migration adds a role column defaulting to admin so existing accounts become admins, then sets the default to editor.

The quest_stages migration creates quests_stages and quests_stages_objectives with their locales tables, and the quest_guide_dungeon_picks migration creates quest_guides_summary_needs_dungeons with locales and version twins.
